title: Baby-G Unisex Watch BA-110GA-1ADR
description: These new BA-110 Series additions combine attractive colors with a subdued matte finish. These models come in a choice of four colors: basic black and white, and trendy ecru and light gray. Gold metal parts used for hour markers and face elements provide attractive accents, while 3D faces provide a feeling of depth. The one-tone colors and metal elements create cool, unobtrusive designs.
